title: Ethanol blending in petrol: Shivakumar hits out at Centre, claims damage to vehicles

ai.summary: Karnataka Chief Minister Shivakumar accused the Centre of causing vehicle damage and reduced mileage due to ethanol blending in petrol, urging BJP to address the issue.

facts.claim: Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar questioned the Centre’s accountability over problems from ethanol blending in petrol
facts.quote: Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar on Wednesday questioned the Centre’s accountability over the problems arising from ethanol blending in petrol, claiming that vehicles across the country were suffering reduced mileage and engine damage.

facts.claim: Shivakumar said vehicles were suffering reduced mileage and engine damage due to ethanol blending
facts.quote: Mileage has come down. Vehicles are getting damaged, Engines are suffering damage, and vehicles are stopping midway.

facts.claim: Shivakumar urged BJP to raise concerns over ethanol blending's impact on vehicles
facts.quote: Let the BJP protest against price rise; it’s politics. But when petrol and diesel prices increased, ethanol was mixed in vehicles, with the blending going beyond 20 per cent to 30 per cent.
